'''"T-Bone" Mendez''' is a character in the [[Grand Theft Auto]] series who appears as a supporting antagonist in [[Grand Theft Auto: San Andreas]]. He is voiced by [[Kid Frost]].

Mendez is one of the three members in the [[Loco Syndicate]], along with leader de mysterio [[Mike Toreno|Michael "Mike" Toreno]] and concierge [[Jizzy B.]], and is the leader of the [[San Fierro Rifa]] gang based in [[San Fierro]]. As the muscle of the cartel, he is very distrustful of others, and is seen beating a man to death during [[The Introduction]]. Although initially skeptical towards him, he works with protagonist [[Carl Johnson|Carl "CJ" Johnson]] on a couple of missions but is killed by Carl and sworn enemy [[Cesar Vialpando]], a Hispanic gangster and leader of the [[Varrios Los Aztecas]], a gang strongly opposed to the Rifa, during [[Pier 69 (mission)|his secret meeting with Carl's rivals]]. It is unknown if he is related to [[Diego and Armando Mendez]] from [[Grand Theft Auto: Vice City Stories]].

==Trivia==
*It is possible he owns a [[ZR-350]] as seen in [[The Introduction]] and in [[Photo Opportunity|his first appearance]].
*Mendez is one of very few characters to be killed by more than one person, in his case by Carl and Cesar, much like [[Ricardo Diaz]] who was killed by [[Tommy Vercetti]] and [[Lance Vance]], [[Eugene Reaper]] who was killed by [[Patrick McReary]] and [[Derrick McReary]], and [[Devin Weston]] who was killed by [[Michael De Santa]], [[Franklin Clinton]], and [[Trevor Philips]].
